headline: Moneyboxx Finance submits AGM voting results
hook: Annual meeting results filed for Moneyboxx
summary: Moneyboxx Finance has filed the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The filing confirms the outcome of shareholder resolutions presented during the meeting. This is a routine regulatory disclosure for the company's stakeholders.
why_it_matters: Routine procedural update with no immediate impact on share price.

headline: Moneyboxx Finance raises ₹84 crore in fresh debt
hook: New debt funding secured for Moneyboxx
summary: Moneyboxx Finance has raised ₹84 crore through a fresh debt issuance. The company has added Bandhan Bank as a new lender as part of this funding round. This capital infusion is intended to support the company's ongoing lending operations. The announcement was officially filed with the NSE on October 1, 2026.
why_it_matters: Increased liquidity supports Moneyboxx's loan book expansion plans.
winners_losers: Moneyboxx gains / Shareholders benefit from growth capital
